references.text: Moses gathered the entire congregation at the entrance of the tent of meeting, just as he did here in chapter 9. This shows the pattern for how the people were to assemble before the Lord's presence.
Aaron and his sons were brought forward to the entrance of the tent of meeting, establishing the practice of coming before the Lord's presence.

The Levites were brought forward before the tent of meeting, and the entire congregation of Israel was gathered, in the same way that the whole assembly came forward and stood before the Lord's presence.
The glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle, and this is the place where the people now stand before the Lord's presence.
Moses and Joshua stood in the tent of meeting before the Lord's presence, showing the same practice of coming before God at the sanctuary.
The congregation was to bring the offering before the tent of meeting, which corresponds to the whole assembly coming forward and standing before the Lord's presence.
